max_num_batched_tokens.source: vLLM default token budget per step (chunked prefill)

capture_sizes.source: vLLM default CUDA-graph capture sizes: 1, 2, 4, then multiples of 8 up to 512

host_step_s.source: host time per step a + b x batch: unmeasured default; measure with a tiny-model decode batch sweep

async_scheduling.source: host work in series with the GPU step unless async scheduling is on

prefix_caching.source: vLLM default: a prompt group's shared prefix is computed and stored once

cascade_attention.source: shared-prefix KV read once per group only with cascade attention

reserve_bytes.source: non-torch memory and CUDA graph pool: read from vLLM's startup log ('Available KV cache memory', 'CUDA graph pool memory')

allreduce_paths.source: vLLM main@573f2f9 on sm 9.0 without FlashInfer: vllm/distributed/device_communicators/{all_reduce_utils.py, custom_all_reduce.py, symm_mem.py, cuda_communicator.py}, csrc/custom_all_reduce.cuh. Per-path latencies are unmeasured defaults.
